summary: The diff implements REQ-3 (Delivery in 10 Mins label on ProductCard) and REQ-2 frontend display logic (delivery charge breakdown on checkout page, DeliveryFeeInfo component). However, REQ-1 (backend delivery charge logic in backend/main.mo) appears to be missing — the backend file diff does not show any new ₹5 delivery fee logic for orders below ₹51 within 1km, and the delivery charge amount is not returned as part of the order/checkout response.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend order placement logic applies a ₹5 delivery fee when order total < ₹51 and distance is ≤ 1km; no delivery charge when order total is ₹51 or above; the delivery charge amount is returned as part of the order/checkout response.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend/main.mo diff is truncated but shows no evidence of a ₹5 delivery fee threshold logic, no FREE_DELIVERY_THRESHOLD constant, and no updated Order type or placeOrder response that returns a deliveryCharge field. The existing deliveryFeePerKm=20 constant is present but no new conditional logic for the ₹51 threshold within ≤1km is visible.

hallucinated_features.description: DeliveryFeeInfo standalone alert component explaining the full delivery policy
hallucinated_features.reason: A new DeliveryFeeInfo.tsx component was created as a standalone informational alert. The requirement only asked for line items in the checkout breakdown showing delivery charge or free delivery status, not a separate policy explanation alert component.
